name: Infinite Gradient Carousel
description: Full-screen infinite 3D image carousel with inertial wheel and drag scrolling, where a blurred animated gradient background takes its colors from the image nearest the center.
contents: Looping row of portrait image cards in 3D perspective
Blurred canvas gradient background tinted by the centered image
Loading spinner overlay shown until images are decoded
behavior: Cards fade and rise in sequentially after images load
Mouse wheel and drag add velocity with friction-based inertia, looping endlessly
Cards rotate, scale and push in depth by distance from center, outer cards blur
Background gradient colors are extracted from each image and tween when the centered card changes
Animation pauses when the tab is hidden
editableByProps: Images, card width, radius and spacing
Scroll feel: friction, wheel and drag sensitivity
Background colors, gradient transition speed and loader color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change entry animation timing or offsets

needsCodeEdit.where: canvas element className with the blur filter

fixed: Mouse wheel over the carousel is captured and prevented from scrolling the page
Image color extraction needs CORS-enabled image sources
Preload link tags are added to document head and removed on unmount
Stage is full-bleed and fills the viewport height
